Messages.Author: SirTemple
Messages.Body:
Question, I know you can attempt to bloc without enough intercept and fail, and
that you can not add extra intercept unless you need it to block, but can I add
intercet to my minion, and chose not to block?

Jason

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. You cannot add intercept unless you need it, and you only need
it when you are attempting to block (and the acting minion's stealth
exceeds your current intercept).
